title: Cloud Engineer
description_html:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.
  • Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.
  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.
  • Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).
  • Kubernetes/EKS experience.
  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer - DGX Cloud
description_html: NVIDIA is looking for an outstanding, passionate, and dedicated Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer to join our DGX Cloud group. This engineering role will design, build and maintain large-scale production systems with high efficiency and availability using a combination of software and systems engineering practices. This role demands knowledge across different systems, networking, coding, databases, capacity management, continuous delivery and deployment, and open-source cloud-enabling technologies like Kubernetes and OpenStack.    The DGX Cloud Production Engineer at NVIDIA ensures our GPU cloud services deliver maximum reliability and uptime. They carefully prepare and plan changes to the system. They also manage capacity and performance. NVIDIA values diversity, curiosity, problem-solving, and openness. Our team includes people with varied backgrounds and perspectives. We encourage collaboration, big thinking, and risk-taking without blame. We promote self-direction on meaningful projects. We also provide support and mentorship to foster learning and growth.     What You’ll Be Doing:     Design, build, deploy, and run internal tooling for large-scale AI training and inferencing platform built on top of cloud infrastructure.    Conduct in-depth performance characterization and analysis on large multi-GPU and multi-node clusters.    Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.    Support services before they become available through activities such as system design consulting, developing software tools, platforms, and frameworks, capacity management, and launch reviews.    Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.    Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.    Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.    Be part of an on-call rotation to support production systems.       What We Need To See:     BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent experience.    5+ years of experience.    A track record showing a good balance between initiating your own projects, convincing others to collaborate with you, and collaborating well on projects initiated by others.    Background in infrastructure automation and distributed systems architecture focused on building tools to manage large-scale private or public cloud platforms in production.    Experience working with one or more of the following languages: Python, Go, C/C++, Java.    Comprehensive understanding in one or more of Linux, Networking, Storage, and Containers Technologies.    Experience with Public Cloud and Infrastructure as a Code (IAAC) and Terraform.    Distributed system experience.       Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:     Interest in crafting, analyzing, and fixing large-scale distributed systems.    Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.    Capability to identify issues and improve code performance while automating routine tasks. Experience in operating or handling large private and public cloud systems based on Kubernetes or Slurm.      NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. If you're creative and self-motivated, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services.     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 14, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineering - EDA Infrastructure
description_html: NVIDIA is hiring engineers to build and operate the governed infrastructure platform behind our Electronic Design Automation (EDA) and hardware engineering organization, giving teams a self-service path from source code to production that runs in the cloud and at each physical site. We need engineers with strong programming skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems. You should have real experience operating large-scale production infrastructure and the judgment to build a platform capability once, for every team that needs it.   The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the cloud-native stack, from Kubernetes down to cluster schedulers. When a new capability is needed, you look for an existing open-source solution before writing your own. What you do build gets built once on the platform, for every team to use. You enjoy solving complex operational problems and turning manual handoffs into self-service, and you care about developer experience as much as you care about uptime. You want systems that stay reliable as the fleet and the number of onboarded teams grow. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.    What You Will Be Doing:    Own the lifecycle of the Kubernetes clusters the platform runs on, including the control plane, node lifecycle, and fleet-wide upgrades. Own the bare-metal provisioning, storage, and networking underneath them too.  Build self-service capabilities (compute, secrets, certificates, DNS, access, deployment) so engineering teams can declare what they need and get it automatically.  Extend Kubernetes with controllers and operators, using open-source projects where they fit and writing your own where they don’t.  Own the CI/CD pipelines and shared platform services, such as policy, autoscaling and observability, that give teams a secure path to production by default.  Onboard new teams and sites onto the platform as a repeatable motion. Define what a site or team needs to bring online, then build the self-service tooling and documentation that gets them there and lets them operate independently afterward.  Work directly with EDA, infrastructure, networking, storage, and hardware engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions for critical chip-design workloads.  Share on-call duties, including incident response, root-cause analysis and capacity planning.     What We Need To See:    5+ years of software engineering or infrastructure engineering experience supporting large-scale production systems. You should be able to describe specific incidents you debugged: what broke, and what you changed as a result.  A BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.  Strong programming experience in Go or Python, including a solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, testing, and software design, with services you have personally built and can walk through in depth. Go is our primary language and preferred, though deep experience in another systems language works too.  Real production experience operating Kubernetes, or a comparable large-scale platform such as an internal developer platform or another cluster manager, with hands-on ownership of specific clusters and components.  Experience building automation that makes decisions and takes action on distributed infrastructure, such as reconciliation loops, controllers, operators, or self-healing remediation systems.  Understanding of performance, security, reliability, fault tolerance, state management, and data consistency in complex systems, built through real infrastructure automation, deployment, and operational recovery work.  A track record of onboarding or migrating other teams onto new infrastructure as a repeatable process: self-service tooling, readiness checks, and documentation that let other teams operate independently afterward.  Strong communication skills and the ability to work optimally across teams, organizations, and geographic regions. You bring a systematic approach to problem solving, a strong sense of ownership, and a habit of eliminating operational toil.     Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:    Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects, such as bug fixes or features you sent upstream instead of working around them.  Experience running Kubernetes on bare metal with tools like Cluster API, Metal3, Ceph, or Cilium. Exposure to EDA applications, license-management systems, high-throughput batch workloads, or semiconductor design workflows is a plus.  Hands-on experience with writing your own operators or the cloud-native ecosystem, such as cert-manager, external-dns, Argo CD, or Kyverno.  A track record of being the engineer other teams' onboarding or migration efforts route through. You build the paved road other people's migrations travel on.  You've also improved infrastructure reliability, utilization, and recovery time through production-quality automation, operating infrastructure across multiple data centers or heterogeneous hardware environments, on-premises and in the cloud.    NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the industry working with us. If you are creative, autonomous, and excited to build reliable infrastructure at scale, we want to hear from you!   Join a team of engineers at NVIDIA dedicated to scaling the AI infrastructure that powers cutting-edge data science applications. Our team solves complex challenges across datacenter hardware, networking, distributed systems, and software deployment. We collaborate closely to design and deliver leading infrastructure solutions. We value strong technical foundations paired with creative thinking and a bias toward execution. Together, we continuously push boundaries, grow our skills, and advance NVIDIA’s capacity to build and deploy AI-based infrastructure at scale.     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors.
